About Citizen Veg Exports

Made in India. Trusted worldwide.

Citizen Veg Exports is India's trusted dehydrated vegetables division — specialising in premium onion, garlic, spice powder and vegetable flake exports. We operate a modern, hygienic facility that delivers consistent quality at bulk export capacity.

Our Story

25 years of building export trust.

Citizen Veg Exports began with a single mission: to bring the best of India's agricultural abundance to kitchens and food manufacturers worldwide. Over 25 years, we have grown from a regional supplier into a globally recognised export brand.

Our facility in Gujarat operates multi-stage dehydration lines, precision milling units and automated quality-control systems — all under one roof. This vertical integration gives us full control over quality from raw material sourcing to the final sealed container.

Today, we supply dehydrated onions, garlic, vegetable powders and flakes to food manufacturers, importers and distributors across 30+ countries. Our export documentation, packaging flexibility and responsive team make us the partner of choice for serious global buyers.

25+

How we deliver quality

Four pillars that define every batch we produce and ship.

Naturally Sourced

Direct farm partnerships, full traceability and seasonality planning ensure we always have the freshest raw material.

Modern Manufacturing

Multi-stage dehydration, precision milling and automated sieving lines ensure uniform particle size and colour across every batch.

Food-Safety First

GMP, HACCP, ISO 22000 protocols enforced at every step. On-site QC lab with chemical, microbiological and sensory testing.

Built for Export

Container-load capacity with port-optimised logistics, custom packaging options and full export documentation support.
